notes: Primary product: cloud-native agent-assist and post-call intelligence for mid-size contact centers.
Contact: CTO Alex Rivera (prefers technical deep-dives). Leading PoC with ops lead Jaime Ortiz.
Main ask: automated post-call summaries that are QA-ready (summary + coaching bullets + redactable PII).
Transcript specifics: 8k calls/month currently, 60% inbound voice, avg call length 6m, multi-channel (phone + webchat). Need speaker diarization + timestamps.
Quality targets: summary fidelity > 90% on key intents, highlight extraction recall for coaching > 85%, false-positive PII redaction < 2%.
Latency constraints: agent whisper latency < 250ms for single-turn suggestions; post-call batch can be async but first summary available within 90s preferred.
Reliability: must handle 3x traffic spikes (seasonal peaks) without >200ms penalty on whisper path; interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput.
Integrations: Zendesk ticket creation + updates, Genesys Cloud routing hooks; wants function-calling to push summaries/tags into ticket fields.
Security: strict retention policy (30 days for raw audio, 12 months for redacted transcripts), encryption at rest w/ customer-managed keys (KMS).
Evaluation plan: ingest anonymized batch of recorded calls (5k) -> run scoring rubric (summaries + QA tags) -> compare to human QA baseline.
Quote from CTO on kickoff call: 'We need something that won't blow up our latency during peak hours — and summaries that our supervisors can rely on for coaching.'
Pricing sensitivity: mid-high; will pay for predictable latency and 24x7 support; expects ROI via agent shrinkage and faster QA cycles.
Preferred deployment: Dedicated pools in NA + VPC control plane for auditability. Enterprise contract likely if POC metrics hit targets.
Requested artifacts: security FAQ, SOC2 report, latency benchmark for Llama2-variant and quantized models, POC SOW template.
Internal champions: Head of Ops (Jaime Ortiz), QA Lead (Nora Chen), Platform Eng (Imran Shah).
Potential red flags: legal wants explicit prohibition on model training with customer audio; need clear clause for model tuning and data use.
Notes about tooling: wants function-calling to support 'create_ticket', 'append_coaching_note', 'flag_for_review' actions from the model output; sample payloads asked for.
They asked about streaming partial transcripts for near-real-time supervisor alerts (escalation triggers) — we proposed lightweight webhook + prefix caching.
Competitive differentiator for them: transparent latency/cost tradeoffs, ability to pin older model versions during regressions, and explicit runbook for spike mitigation.

use_case_summary: Post-call summaries: structured TL;DR + key intents + recommended ticket tags for auto-creation in Zendesk.
QA & coaching: extract top 3 coaching opportunities per call with timestamps and verbatim snippets for supervisor playbooks.
Agent assist (whisper): single-turn suggested responses and next-best-action with <250ms L2 latency during live calls.
Tool-calling: function outputs to create/update tickets, add QA scores, and flag calls for manual review.
Reliability under spikes: autoscaling policies + fallback to cheaper model variants for non-whisper workloads; explicit SLO for whisper path.
